# package secevent

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-sunspec/secevent"
```

Package secevent exposes the go-modbus security event API for SunSpec servers. Set [modbus.ServerConfig.Security](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-modbus#ServerConfig.Security) to a [SecurityPolicy](#type-securitypolicy) when calling [modbus.NewServer](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-modbus#NewServer) or serving a SunSpec device with Server.Serve. Applications importing this package must select a go-modbus version that provides security events. See the go-sunspec README for the fork pin.

### func Report

```go

```
